compute_mask_areas: compute the area of binary masks stored in a numpy array of shape [N, height, width]
compute_pairwise_intersection: compute pairwise intersection areas between two sets of binary masks
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two sets of binary masks
compute_pairwise_ioa: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two sets of binary masks
review_mask_ops_module: review the np_mask_ops module and its area, intersection, iou, and ioa functions
